_comment: Issue #421 items I3 + M2 -- THE ORDER PROOF for the [Dangersense] world overlay across a GH#374 defeat grace. Route: stand at (23,10) with both night regions rendered -> step DOWN into road_mothbears' radius-1 square -> the ambush fires and the region set tears down (ui_dangersense_cleared, M2's teardown observable; before #421 an emptied overlay emitted nothing at all and QA could not tell 'the warning went away' from 'the feature was never wired') -> LOSE the fight -> Continue reloads auto_pre_combat at (23,11) with the invisible exit grace armed, so the mothbear region is correctly ABSENT while the grace suppresses the ambush -> step UP out of the radius: the grace lapses inside _check_trigger_radius and the warning square must come back ON THAT STEP. That last wait is I3's whole subject: move_player emits player_moved BEFORE the proximity pass, so before the encounter_grace_ended seam the overlay reconciled against pre-lapse ward state and the region only reappeared one step later -- the step back IN, simultaneously with the ambush. The combat_started count is pinned at 1 across that reveal to prove the warning arrived while the player was still safe, then at 2 after the deliberate step back in.

steps._comment: Both live night regions, deterministically sorted by encounter id -- the same pinned geometry dangersense_field_loop holds, re-read here as the BEFORE picture of the teardown. ORDER TRAP: the first reconcile rides _rebuild_field and lands BETWEEN game_loaded and world_ready, so this wait must sit above the world_ready one or the since-cursor steps straight past it.
== M2: step into the radius, the ambush fires, and the overlay's region set goes EMPTY. `cleared` names both encounters that were being warned about a beat earlier.
The weaponless level-5 build loses to the T3 mothbear pair; defeat_ally_alive's reload idiom follows (confirm -> ui_combat_hidden -> game_loaded off the auto_pre_combat slot, no game_reset).

auto_pre_combat is written AT combat_started, so the reload lands INSIDE the radius at (23,11) with the grace armed -- and the overlay honestly shows no warning for a fight that cannot currently spring.

== I3: THE EXIT STEP. Leaving the radius lapses the grace inside _check_trigger_radius, which runs AFTER move_player's player_moved -- so the warning square must be restored by the post-check encounter_grace_ended beat, not one step later.

STILL ONE fight so far: the warning came back while the player stood safely outside the square. That is the whole difference the fix makes -- pre-fix this reveal and the second combat_started landed on the SAME step.
== and the ambush is genuinely armed again: walking back in springs it, exactly as GH#374 intends.
